rows.title: Rent words route to rent, a memo stays a send
rows.defect: any words may sit between the verb and 'rent'
rows.test: 'pay sam 900 for rent' is not the rent flow

rows.title: Only what is missing is asked
rows.defect: a missing day is assumed to be the 1st

rows.title: The setup card saves nothing
rows.defect: the rule is saved when the card goes up, before the yes
rows.test: a card drains no write; the yes inserts the exact row

rows.title: NO saves nothing
rows.defect: a NO on a setup or change card is taken as the yes
rows.test: NO on setup and on change writes nothing

rows.title: Next month's card past the due day
rows.defect: next month is 30 days after this month's due day
rows.test: on Oct 29 the card is November's, due Nov 1

rows.title: Staged, never sent
rows.defect: the staged reply claims the rent was sent
rows.test: the staged reply says the person sends it

rows.title: A late month, never before the rule
rows.defect: the rule's start date is not checked
rows.test: a rule set up on the 2nd is not offered October

rows.title: Never staged twice
rows.defect: only this session's staged list is checked, not the saved month
rows.test: a month the table says is staged is not carded again

rows.title: Stop rent in one message
rows.defect: stop turns it off in memory only

rows.title: A change is restated
rows.defect: the amount is not compared, so a new amount is 'already your rent'

rows.title: 10-minute cards
rows.test: a yes 11 minutes later stages nothing

rows.title: Stop-on-change before staging
rows.defect: the amount is not re-checked at the yes
rows.test: a new amount since the card stops the stage

rows.title: The scheduler only says when
rows.defect: the staged month is not checked
rows.test: a staged month is not offered again

rows.title: The 1st to the 28th
rows.defect: any day of the month is accepted

rows.title: The payee after pay
rows.defect: only 'to' names the payee, so 'pay mike' asks who
rows.test: pay mike on zelle names Mike

rows.title: No rent on file, said
rows.defect: a due-date question with nothing on file gets only the bare setup question
rows.test: when is rent due says no rent is set up
